visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a man in a black tank top and a woman in a black dress decorating a green Christmas tree adorned with ornaments and a gold star. Several wrapped gift boxes are visible at the base of the tree against a plain gray background. (2) The man, smiling broadly, holds a cardboard box filled with colorful round ornaments; he gestures toward the tree while speaking. (3) Close-up on the woman in the black dress who holds a large red Christmas stocking with white fur trim, looking excited with wide eyes and an open mouth. (4) A second woman with brown hair, wearing glasses and animal-ear headbands, enters the frame from the side; her arms are on her hips, and she wears a skeptical, unimpressed facial expression. (5) The woman in the black dress moves to a gray double-door closet and opens it wide with both hands. (6) The interior of the closet is filled with small, colorful round spirits wearing red Santa hats, a large brown teddy bear, and miniature Christmas trees. (7) The spirits and a small yellow dog jump out; the spirits surround the skeptical woman, dragging her downward and toward the closet as she expresses shock with wide eyes. (8) The woman is pulled completely into the dark closet, and the gray door slams shut, leaving only the door handle visible. (9) Back to the tree scene, the man and woman look at each other with wide-eyed realization. (10) Transition to real-world product footage: three colorful cups (red, green, dark red) with "Merry Christmas" text and bear illustrations are displayed. (11) Close-up of a human hand holding a small, round, cream-filled cookie between fingers, showcasing its texture. (12) A red cardboard box with festive illustrations unfolds to reveal the product cups inside. (13) Final animation scene shows the man and woman laughing heartily, surrounded by the magical spirits and the bear. (14) The video ends on a clean white screen featuring a black bear logo and the text "BEAR BAKERY 小熊菓子".

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, fast-tempo orchestral Christmas BGM begins immediately. A male voice speaks with high energy and rapid delivery. (2) A female voice enters with high pitch and enthusiastic prosody, overlapping with the BGM. (3) A third female voice interrupts with a deeper, cynical tone and lower pitch variability. (4) A magical high-frequency shimmering SFX occurs as the dialogue reaches a peak. (5) Multiple small voices begin a melodic, rhythmic chanting ("la la la") in unison. (6) Sound of fabric rustling and scuffling is heard briefly. (7) A sudden, high-arousal female scream rings out, followed by a sharp, percussive thud and door-click SFX. (8) A few seconds of high-pitched "Wow" from the male voice. (9) The first female voice shifts to a professional narrative tone, delivering product information with high articulation clarity. (10) A collective laugh track/laughter SFX triggers, blending with the BGM. (11) BGM swells briefly and then stops abruptly with the final jingle.
